171:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, you two. To draw out the emotions of $$ハマーン・カーン$$, the one they call the Iron Lady...」

171:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thanks to that, $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z were born. Allow me to add them to the unit's stock.」

171:t_10:11.en:
$$クェス$$
「Ha! So even something like that produces $$Ｚチップ$$!」

171:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「People like that carry all sorts of things inside, you see. Once they let their emotions explode, they produce $$Ｚチップ$$ of rather high purity.」

171:t_10:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So that's how it works...」

171:t_10:14.en:
$$クェス$$
「Then next time I fight $$ハマーン$$, maybe I'll make her even angrier.」

171:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, allow me to teach you my very best trash talk.」

171:t_10:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I-If you did that, you wouldn't have enough lives no matter how many you had!」

171:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Pleased to meet you, $$セツコ$$. I am $$ＡＧ$$, an agent robot of $$ＤＥＭ$$.」

171:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, $$セツコ$$...! A humble robot like me has no need for a title. Please call me 'AG!' as if you were spitting it out.」

171:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, my... What's the matter? You're acting as timid as you used to be.」

171:t_10:26.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$シン$$ told me I'd better stay away from you, so...」

171:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And yet you've come to visit anyway, which means you're simply bursting with curiosity about my lovable body.」

171:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now... $$セツコ$$, since you've become a member of $c, there is something you must do.」

171:t_10:30.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That... $$シン$$ didn't tell me about that either, but...」

171:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, may I borrow your ear... I'll tell you in secret.」

171:t_10:32.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Does it have to be a secret?」

171:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$セツコ$$... You're a newcomer, and you can't listen to what your senior tells you?」

171:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of the Right Stuff... A fine answer.」

171:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, pardon me...! My exhaust vent happened to be facing your cute little ear...」

171:t_10:39.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...That's quite enough! I've finished my greetings, so I'll be going now!」

171:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems I went a little too far. I'll reflect on it a bit.」

171:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, my apologies to anyone who was looking forward to it. I'll do today's hawking myself!」

171:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get to it today... Business, business!」

172:t_000:1.en:
$$シン$$
「$$アスラン$$ and the others are with her. She should have been evacuated somewhere safe by now.」

172:t_000:3.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ザフト$$ has fully fallen in with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ as well. I opposed it, and they were about to detain me.」

172:t_000:4.en:
$$シン$$
「But not everyone in $$プラント$$ wants war. $$ラクス$$ is naturally one of them.」

172:t_000:5.en:
$$シン$$
「After I deserted $$ザフト$$, I joined up with people trying to protect the peace, and I've been waiting for a chance to counterattack.」

172:t_000:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Be careful! Mobile suits are coming out of $$プラント$$!」

172:t_001:1.en:
$$シン$$
「I hear $$フル・フロンタル$$ has been working since the days of the $$時獄戦役$$ to bring $$プラント$$ into their own forces.」

172:t_001:4.en:
$n
「$$ヒイロ$$, $$デュオ$$ and the others didn't bring their machines! Until they get clear, we have to buy them time!」

172:t_001:5.en:
$$シン$$
「$$キラ$$! Are you going to let $$ラクス$$'s feelings end right here!」

172:t_001:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's fight, $$キラ$$! For $$ラクス$$'s sake too...!」

172:t_002:2.en:
$n
「$$シン$$! I'll back $$キラ$$ up! Will you be all right over there!」

172:t_002:3.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't worry. $$ルナ$$ is with us.」

172:t_002:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's $$ルナマリア$$, $$シン$$'s girlfriend.」

172:t_002:6.en:
$n
「So she's fighting for something precious too...」

172:t_002:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n... So you've sorted out your feelings about Ensign $$リディ$$.)

172:t_002:11.en:
$$キラ$$
「$c will be here soon...! Until then, we hold out with just us!」

172:t_002:13.en:
$n
(I don't really understand how you felt, fighting for $$オードリー$$, Ensign, but $$キラ$$, $$シン$$ and I all have something that matters to us too...!)

172:t_004:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You made it out safe, $$シン$$!」

172:t_004:2.en:
$$ファ$$
「$$ルナマリア$$ is here too!」

172:t_004:3.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「It's been a while, $$ファ$$. Leave the babysitting of $$シン$$ to me.」

172:t_004:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So $$ネオ・ジオン$$ had already gotten inside $$プラント$$.」

172:t_004:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「But there aren't many of them! Let's clean them up fast and show the people of $$プラント$$ how pointless it is to team up with $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

172:t_004:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I felt it when we infiltrated $$プラント$$, but this doesn't look like a problem that'll be settled so easily.」

172:t_004:12.en:
$$シン$$
「That can wait! First we get through this and rescue $$ラクス$$!」

172:t_004:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, deploy! We're going to hit the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces stationed in $$プラント$$!」

172:t_004:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But be careful. Assume this battle won't end so easily!」
